title: Volume change B→C
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the volume change from state B to state C as ΔV = V_C - V_B = 2V_0/3.

title: Heat exchanged B→C→A
description: Essential: Correctly identifies the net heat exchanged during the process B→C→A as Q = 2p_0V_0.

title: First law application
description: Important: Applies the first law of thermodynamics (ΔU = Q + W) correctly to the process B→C→A, noting ΔU=0 for the cycle.

title: Process identification
description: Important: Identifies processes B→C (isobaric) and C→A (isochoric) from the p-T diagram and uses corresponding gas laws.

title: Work calculation
description: Important: Correctly calculates work done on/by the gas during the isobaric process B→C (W_BC = -pΔV = -2p_0V_0).

title: State property analysis
description: Optional: Explicitly determines volumes at B (V_0/3) and C (V_0) using gas laws and given diagram information.

title: Sign convention error
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign convention for work (e.g., positive for work done on gas when calculating heat via first law).

title: Cyclic process oversight
description: Pitfall: Fails to recognize that ΔU=0 for the complete cycle A→B→C→A, leading to an incorrect heat calculation.
